verdict.rationale: The pack contains no first-party security-posture documentation: nothing on which skills may execute, no trust model for third-party or agent-written skills, and no telemetry disclosure. The only telemetry evidence is a community comment noting telemetry exists and can be opted out of, which does not show the project documents it. The /cso and /review skills audit the user's own code and say nothing about gstack's posture; the local learnings file and domain-skill injection are feature descriptions, not a trust model.
